segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let iso860Source = "2022-07-14 Lemon-lime slushie $1.99" let matcher = Regex { Capture { One(.iso8601Date(timeZone: TimeZone(identifier: "PST")!, dateSeparator: .dash)) } OneOrMore(.horizontalWhitespace) OneOrMore(.any) OneOrMore(.horizontalWhitespace) One(.localizedCurrency(code:Locale.Currency("USD"), locale:Locale(identifier: "en_US"))) } let match = iso860Source.firstMatch(of: matcher) let date = match?.1 // date == Jul 14, 2022 at 12:00 AM PST ```
